That was written when the path was in flight and was already false — heic-decode 2.1.0 is a production dependency and this package is in main's lockfile — so the public notices page would have rendered 'In development — not yet shipped' for a component we actually distribute, disclaiming a live attribution obligation. See scripts/security/license-denylist.allowlist.json for the compliance rationale (unmodified, browser-only, isolated in the lazy 'vendor-heic' chunk, which vite.config.ts now really implements) and the counsel x265/encoder verification result.
